coins: BTC, BUSD, DAI, ETH, USDC, USDT
source detail: <SYMBOL>-USD daily bars; see the price_source column for which vendor supplied each row
columns: coin, date, open, high, low, close, volume_usd, price_source
notes: Quoted against USD, not USDT. Includes BTC and ETH alongside the stablecoins. Volume is vendor-dependent and differs materially between vendors.

Stablecoins only. Gaps are left unfilled. Market cap is not stored: it is prices.close x supply.circulating_supply. Several tokens share a symbol on DefiLlama, so ids are tried largest-first and the first with data in the window is used; check the build log for which id won.
Market-wide, not per coin. Join on date alone.

coins: DAI, PAX, USDC, USDT, UST, wLUNA
source detail: Stanford ERC20-stablecoins transfers file aggregated to daily totals with duckdb; the BigQuery extension is appended as-is. See the onchain_source column.
columns: coin, date, n_transfers, onchain_volume, n_unique_senders, n_unique_receivers, minted, burned, volume_large_transfers, onchain_source
notes: Ethereum only, so most USDT activity (Tron) is missing and BUSD is absent entirely. Counts and sums only. Stanford file covers Apr-Nov 2022; 2023 needs the BigQuery file, exported with values already divided by 10**decimals. Aggregated with duckdb when installed, otherwise with a slower chunked-pandas path giving the same result.
Several events can share a date and some dates have none.

Base tables only. Nothing here is derived from anything else in this folder: no returns, volatility, deviations, labels, regime or merged panel. Build those downstream. Timestamps are tz-naive UTC. Regenerated by build_dataset.py -- do not hand-edit.
